description: Super Pong C-140 colour, taken from the game's packaging art (spec section 3.1): the background is black; the border and the foreground are each a gradient through a few anchor colours placed at the X of the box-art element they were read from. Colour depends only on the cell kind and the clock column X.
form: background = (0, 0, 0). Drawn kinds: the sRGB anchors are converted to OKLab, interpolated linearly in L, a, b between the two anchors around X, held at the end anchors' colours beyond them, converted back to sRGB and rounded to 0..=255.
black_and_white: grey = luma of the kind (a property of the signal, not of the colours); the background is 0
stripes: per kind: add stripe * cos(2 pi ((j + 0.5) / 4 - stripe_peak)) to R, G and B for sub-column j = 0..4 before the clamp; the background has none

basis.source: Atari Super Pong C-140 packaging art; palette and texture contract in docs/SPEC-superpong.md section 3
basis.anchor_x: the native clock columns of the elements the colours were read from: left paddle/wall X 16-19, left digits X 24-55, net X 88-91, right digits X 120-151, right paddle/wall X 160-163
